answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in plume, checked in falcon, and canyon makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 14 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4481 identities would post 4078 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
